digest.component_or_area: workflow step registry and seam tests
propositions: workflow step registry membership cannot be statically verified because registration depends on import side effects that have no structural guard; missed imports vanish silently and are caught only at runtime on executed paths

the seam test asserting headroom on gate_dispatch.py cites stale rationale about finalize_verdict call sites that were relocated to plan_review_recovery.py and workflow_ops.py; the assertion message no longer reflects the actual code structure
plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC) lack headroom guards while other files have them; two unguarded files above threshold create regrowth risk

an in-process registry membership check is masked by test-module imports that substitute for production imports; the guard must run in a subprocess with clean sys.modules to observe true first-import behavior
the gate-YAML resolution check reads the same process-global STEP_REGISTRY and suffers identical masking; it must also run in subprocess isolation to be a functional guard
